The State Of Madhya Pradesh vs M/S Sharma Namkin Sendhwa
Shri Ravi ... on 12 December, 2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Ind:35362
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Binod Kumar Dwivedi
 On The 12th Of December, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 21164 of 2023
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Versus
 M/S Sharma Namkin Sendhwa Shri Ravi Sharma And
 Others 
 Appearance: 
 Shri Ajay Raj Gupta - Panel Lawyer for the applicants
 Shri Vinayak Balchandani - Advocate for respondents N
 Order 
This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for restoration of M.Cr.C.No.18501/2022,
which was dismissed in default on 12/05/2022 by Registry in compliance of the order dated 22/04/2022.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that that M.Cr.C. was filed challenging the order dated 18/11/2021 passed by Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Barwani and due to inadvertence order dated 22/04/2022 could not be complied with by curing the defect. 
Petition has been opposed by learned counsel for the respondent on the ground that instead of filing M.Cr.C., MCC should be filed. 
After hearing the rival contentions, mere change in nature of proceeding or wrong mention of section, should not come in way of dispensing with of justice. The reason assigned by counsel for the applicant appears to be bona fide , hence petition is allowed and NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-IND:35362 2 MCRC-21164-2023 M.Cr.C.No.18501/2022, which was dismissed in default by the Registry on 12/05/2022 for non-compliance of the order dated 22/04/2022, is hereby restored to its original number. Counsel for the applicants is directed to cure the defects in M.Cr.C.
Let a copy of this order be placed in the record of M.Cr.C.No.18501/2022. 
(BINOD KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE Tej The State Of Madhya Pradesh vs M/S Sharma Namkin Sendhwa Shri Ravi ... on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159594252/
